notes.title: Complete Rewrite & Engine switch.
notes.content:
The rewrite for [b]They are Hundreds[/b] is well underway, we have many things to share but this announcement will be brief as we are still working and plan to share much more later.

Some backstory, They are Hundreds has switched skins and identity multiple times. 

Originally, the game was a Third Person tower defense game that was later scraped completely to go into survival. The art style as well shifted, multiple times. We want to iron this out, stick to something and form a strong Identity of the game. 

Understandably, there are some negative reviews/feelings about the game. I think all of it is fair, and justified, we had a pretty crap game! I want to mend those feelings/reviews and put something out that we can be proud of, and deliver what we promised.

Moving forward They are hundreds will take place in Southern Texas, on the brink of collapse you must recruit forces, and rebuild a failing city and protect trade routes from hordes of people who fell victim to a new plague. 

In the new They are hundreds, you will be able to recruit soldiers, assign them to protect your city or trade carts. Recruit civilians to mine, upkeep and heal your soldiers. Unlock upgrades for your cities defenses and much more.

We are very excited to share what we have, and where we are going. We plan to work on the game to completion and drop it all ready to go, or drop it in pieces as we work on it and provide updates to it along the way. What would you like to see? 

Have ideas or questions? Feel free to leave them on this post, and I will respond to them all!


If you are interested in updates more frequently I encourage you to join our discord:
https://discord.gg/fg6k9cshgn


Thank you all!

notes.title: Patch & Price Change! Crafting & More!
notes.content:
[i]Hello everyone, I actually can't believe I was able to post this update. Last night when the patch was ready to be posted, my main HDD died thus I thought the files of the game were gone. I was able to recover the files, and game files and with that I give you this![/i]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/b10ecd5f6f07cc2d2f4cbe4405c79308567898c7.jpg[/img]

[h1] Main Changes [/h1]

- Time of day speed 5x faster. 
- Start with pistol, ammo, and food. 
- Chests now only contain food, beds, ammo with the only firearm being a pistol. **More on this later**
- There is a new crawler zombie, slow but more shots are required!
- New hell hound, Fast, and hard to kill. 
- AI FOV lowered. 
- Crafting??
- Removal of most firearms on the map, only one m4 and shotgun can be found. 
- Camp fires now give more light. 
- Armor (Testing) reduces damage taken from firearms. 
- Performance changes. 
- Main menu camera replacement

[h1]Crafting[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/309d097b59ba74dde28ffe393612e56bbb41a71d.jpg[/img]

No longer will you search endlessly for those pesky bullets! 

If you hover over the item you desire to craft, it will tell you what is required.
For example, the shotgun and m4 will require Iron bars. You must first craft iron bars, then the weapon. Why? Doing this adds more depth to the game, and hopefully will extend life time. 

FAQ - Can i still find weapons without crafting? Yes pistols, and one m4 and shotgun. 

I cannot find a pickaxe laying around, what do I do! You can find them in the chests located around the map. 

It is dark! You can access a flashlight completely free in the crafting menu!

[h1]The Crawler[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/9c1cf72149bb1d1fd8003c0632f308f0fc05dae0.jpg[/img]


Takes only 3 shots to kill, while not that strong they are sneaky!

[h1] The hound[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32069798/76339a77038c58014dbcb63df72f353277a7d968.jpg[/img]

These are fast, and tough creatures. No one knows where it came from, but it will empty your pockets of ammo!

[b] Price change [/b]

Why are you raising the price, and by how much?

I would firstly like to thank everyone who have joined the community, with the 0.99 price tag I had hoped to grow the community and it did! So welcome! 

I am raising the price by 0.99 = 1.99 by the end of the month. Why?
I work a full time job, and with the extra income I could effectively triple the patch count by taking time off of work. 

For example, this patch took me exactly 12.30 Hours. Obviously recovering the data took up some time which is included. I did most of the patch in my one day off. So if i took one, or two more days off a week or even month I could increase the productivity of patches. 

I am still considering this move, however for transparency I have decided to share the idea. I welcome your opinion. 

 There have been a lot of questions about the save system, so i will be making a YouTube video covering the topic shortly. 

Thank you all for your continued support, I read all of the reviews and am truly grateful. 

- Jake

notes.content:
Hello everyone, ever since the price drop the community has grown a lot! I wish to thank everyone for their interest in They Are Hundreds, the past few months have been a blast!

Tomorrow's patch.

[list]
    [*]Huge Graphical improvements. 
    [*]New options menu
    [*]New option settings, should help with those who cannot run the game well.
    [*]You can now edit the gravity in the game.
    [*]You can now edit your walk speed in the game.
    [*]Upcoming feature within context of prior
- Select if you want infinite ammo
- Select if you want infinite money
- change zombie spawn speed's + how many will spawn.
    [*]New map, this is not easy to run however.
    [*]3 Types of zombies currently. 
- HordeZombies (Only on protect objective map) Will go only for objective untill complete. Follows same damage path as others.
- Sprinters ( All but objective map ) Fast as $%#@, but be careful they take two shots to kill!
- Walkers ( All maps but objective ) Simple walkers, spawn is mass die in mass. One shot to kill.
    [*]Glock now has a flashlight.
    [*]New map has Day/night cycle.
- Eventually you will need a campfire, and zombies will be faster at night.
    [*]New ammo gathering rate, each kill gives you a surplus amount of ammo for Assault rifle.
    [*]New loading screen ( User requested ) I am still changing how it looks I did post a mock up of it in a prior announcement. 
    [*]From six to 3 maps, why? 
- I'm tired of poor quality, I want to put more time into my product to insure it looks better.
    [*]3 Game modes
- Free roam
- Wave linear
- Protect Objective. 
    [*]New running sound with glock. Temporary sound attached to it for now.
    [*]Building system reworked, should now work with no problems please leave post if it does not.
    [*]New HUD in game, I believe it looks better.
    [*]Turret shooting sound is now fixed. You can only hear the shot if within the radius the sound travels.
    [*] Doors, if you hit them they will open. Only on new map currently.
    [*] Removed buggy to rework how it works. 
    [*] [b] BIGGEST [/b] new shooting mechanic, no longer will you shoot endlessly without hitting the zombie. I have tested this new mechanic for 2 hours straight and it works 100%.
    [*]I have the new zombie mechanic done, however please comment below if you want this feature.
- If they see you within 1500m they will chase you, if not they will idle.
Do you want this feature?
    [*]Sprinting speed increased while using glock.
    [*]Let's talk multiplayer.
The multiplayer as we all know, has been far from perfect. I understand the frustration and as this is my first game using multiplayer I was just happy to see it work somewhat, however I am working on a gamesparks server implementation to make the multiplayer better. However I have not done this before and it will take time. 

Survey 
Should I make update video's, or continue to write these? Which do you prefer.
